name: Real estate
description: Builders, developers, brokers and property consultants. Buyers decide after seeing the place, so the site exists to book site visits and to put the brochure in their hands.

goals.prompt: What should the website do for your property business? Name the one or two results that matter most.
goals.why: For a property business the site is judged by site visits booked and brochures downloaded, not by page views.

recommendation.statement: Get qualified buyers to book a site visit
Capture buyer details when they download the brochure
recommendation.metric: brochure downloads with a phone number

goals.reason: The two actions that turn a property enquiry into a sale conversation.

audience.prompt: Who buys or rents from you, and what do they need to see before they will visit?
audience.why: A first-time home buyer, an investor and an NRI need different proof and different pages.

recommendation.segment: Families buying their first or next home
recommendation.need: Prices, floor plans, location and possession date, then a visit
Appreciation, rental yield, builder track record and legal clarity

audience.reason: The two groups most property sites serve; research in P2 refines them.

heroMustHave: A headline that names the project or the promise and the location, not the company name alone
One strong image of the actual project or the neighbourhood, never a stock skyline

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Show the project and the location, prove the builder can be trusted, and move the buyer to book a site visit or take the brochure

pages.title: Projects
pages.purpose: Show every project with its status, configuration, starting price and location so a buyer can shortlist in a minute

pages.title: Amenities and Gallery
pages.purpose: Make the lifestyle real with the amenities, the actual site photographs and the walkthrough

pages.title: About
pages.purpose: Show who is behind the project: the builder's track record, delivered projects and approvals

pages.title: Contact
pages.purpose: Make the visit easy to book, with the site address, the sales office hours and the directions

pages.title: Floor Plans and Pricing
pages.purpose: Give each configuration its floor plan, carpet area and price range so buyers stop guessing

pages.title: Location and Connectivity
pages.purpose: Show what is nearby and how long it takes to reach schools, work, hospitals and transport

pages.title: Construction Updates
pages.purpose: Prove progress with dated photographs, so buyers trust the possession date

pages.title: Home Loan and EMI
pages.purpose: Answer how a buyer will pay: bank partners, eligibility and an EMI calculation

pages.title: Buyer Reviews
pages.purpose: Let happy buyers speak, with names, projects and photographs where they agree

pages.title: Buyer's Guide
pages.purpose: Answer the questions every buyer has about documents, registration, taxes and possession

pages.title: NRI Buyers
pages.purpose: Explain remote booking, power of attorney, remittance and handover for buyers abroad

pages.title: Investors
pages.purpose: Show the investment case with location growth, rental demand and the builder's record, without promising returns

pages.title: Property Insights
pages.purpose: Publish local market guides that bring in buyers searching before they are ready to visit

pages.title: Channel Partners
pages.purpose: Recruit brokers with commission terms, support material and a registration form

questions.prompt: What do you sell or rent?
questions.why: Selling homes, renting commercial space and selling plots each need a different page set and different proof.
questions.reason: The most common property business site.

questions.prompt: How many projects or listings will the site show?
questions.why: One project needs a landing-page feel. Many need filters and a page per project.
questions.reason: A typical builder site shows a few active projects.

questions.why: Buyers leave sites that hide prices, but some builders prefer to give them on a call.

options.label: Show the price of each configuration
On request, after the buyer shares a phone number

questions.reason: A starting price builds interest without committing the sales team.

questions.prompt: Which cities or areas are your projects in, and what is the landmark a buyer knows them by?
questions.why: The hero headline and the location page are built around this.
questions.reason: Needed to write a location-specific headline.

questions.prompt: Which of these do you already have?
questions.why: The brochure is the hero's second action, and real photographs decide how good the site looks.

options.label: Photographs of the site or model flat
A 3D model or render of the building

questions.reason: The minimum a property site needs to look credible.

questions.prompt: Where should enquiries go, and who follows them up?
questions.why: A lead that waits a day is usually lost. The form and the call to action are wired to this.

options.label: A phone call from the sales team

questions.reason: Most property buyers prefer to be reached on WhatsApp first.

questions.prompt: When can buyers visit the site or sales office, and do you offer pick-up?
questions.why: The booking form offers real slots, not an open question.
questions.reason: A common sales-office pattern; replace with the real hours.

questions.prompt: In one sentence, why should a buyer choose you over the other builder down the road?
questions.why: This becomes the hero promise and the about page opening.
questions.reason: A real differentiator cannot be guessed.

questions.prompt: Which two or three competing projects do your buyers compare you with?
questions.why: Research studies them so the site answers the comparisons buyers actually make.

/: hero with the project headline, a proof line, the primary action and the brochure download
featured projects with status, configuration and starting price
why buy from this builder, with registration and delivery proof
a closing site-visit call to action
/projects: a card per project with status, configuration, area, starting price and the visit action
a filter or a clear grouping by status
/contact: the booking form with real slots
address, sales office hours, map and directions

compliance: Show the registration number wherever the regulator requires it, and never publish one the client has not supplied
Never promise returns, appreciation or possession dates the client has not given as facts with a source
Prices and areas on the page must match the price list the client supplied

extras.note: Buyers who cannot visit at once can walk the model flat, which lifts site-visit bookings.
A short drone or construction loop in the hero shows the real project and the neighbourhood.
A 3D building or floor-plan model suits a premium project, if the builder has one to supply.
A location map with nearby places answers the question every buyer asks first.
An EMI calculator keeps buyers on the site and starts the finance conversation.
